avis.texte: I have tried SO hard to love this product but it made me break out SO bad! I loved how light and bubbly it felt on my skin while using but just did not work for me

Bought this after realizing my skin was reacting to the niacinamide in the previous cleanser that I was using for years (causing redness, small blisters). I have been using this cleanser for almost 2 months (7 weeks) and my skin has recovered! I am 22F, have sensitive combination/oily skin and deal with hormonal adult acne. This cleanser is very gentle and does not leave my skin feeling dry. Love this, would absolutely recommend. Will genuinely grieve if the formula ever changes.

Heard Korean skin care is great for skin-I tried Soonjung ph 6.5 Whip Cleanser. I left my sensitive skin burning, very dried out and many hard pimples, I'm 61-I haven't had pimples in years! I'd return it but I threw away original packing so I can't.

Ive been using this cleanser for 6 mos straight. I have sensitive, mature, dry, rosacea, acne prone skin. This has been a holy grail dor myself and my teen daughter. It cleanses gently but EFFECTIVELY without disturbing the skin barrier and stripping the skin. It also works well with double cleansing. I use Banila Clean it Zero from Ulta and this cleanser removes the remaining Banila effortlessly leaving me clean and not irritated. Stop scrolling and buy it already !

For context, I have sensitive acne prone skin. This face wash is just ok to me and I did not continue using it. However, it didnt break me out which is huge!! I just feel it didnt help really cleannn my face ya know? It also caused a bit of dryness for me, but i do have skin on the drier side. I feel this would be best suited to someone who just has sensitive skin and isnt struggling with clogged pores.

I've used this face wash for over a year, it's SO nice as my 2nd step during a double cleanse and as a no-make up day gentle wash. It's soft, unscented, actually cleans, and doesn't irritate my occasional eczema flare ups. Even my dermatologist, who was dubious at first, took a look at the ingredients and was impressed. What's even better-- you can buy refill bags. Ulta, PLEASE start selling these refills! I hate having to clean out pumps for recycling.

This is my favorite cleanser. It feels like it actually cleans my skin without stripping it dry. I have dry, sensitive skin and was diagnosed with rosacea and seb derm recently. Most cleansers would irritate my skin, but this one has been so gentle. My dermatologist prescribed me a sulfa wash which stinks horribly and I haven't touched it since I tried this cleanser. Highly recommend.

Truly a holy grail product for me! I have sensitive, acne-prone skin and react badly to even the simplest cleansers (Cerave, Cetaphil, Ordinary, etc.) I have been using this cleanser for 6 months and it's truly perfect. Non-drying, neutral to no smell, doesn't leave residue, and the cost for the amount you get is amazing. Will be my ride or die for life.
I have dry, sensitive skin, and have been using this around 1 month so far with no issues. This cleans well without stripping or drying out my skin. All around great cleanser!

Recommended by K Beauty influencers, i have been eyeing this for the past year and finally purchased it. Why did I wait so long? THIS is my new HG cleanser! So gentle and effective at cleansing without stripping the skin or causing breakouts! Skin is so soft after I almost never want to use other products after (crazy, I know!) if anything just a moisturizer! Love it and will be repurchasing backups!
Only face wash fhat cleanses but doesnt irritate or break me out and ive tried tons :)

I am in love with this cleanser. I have not been able to find a cleanser that does not leave my skin feeling stripped in years. Funally I found one. This cleanser is extremely gentle and soothing and did not leave my skin tight what so ever. I love it!!

I have rosacea and fungal acne (malassezia yeast). My skin is very sensitive and reactive to a lot of ingredients. This foaming face wash has been my holy grail for the last ~3 years! Works better than even Vanicream for me. Highly recommend it.

I have very sensitive, dry and acne prone skin. Ive used cerave, cetaphil and most recently la roshe posay. Ive had allergic reactions to some or my face never felt clean, like i was washing my face with lotion BUT not with this wash. I get no adverse reaction to it and it leaves my face feeling so clean with stripping it dry, i love it, ive found my new face wash
I 100% love it. My first face wash that ive actually picked up to use again ( not a big skin care girly) but chat gbt put me on and i couldnt be happier fixjng to buy my second bottle ;)

I've used cerave, cetaphil, and vanicream, and this cleanser is by far my favorite gentle cleanser

I brought this cleanser at a K-Beauty shop on vacation and have been using it in the mornings. I can say that its a great morning cleanser, and my skin feels clean without feeling tight. I love the soft texture and the slip makes it easy to spread as I wash my face. It's easy to wash off as well which is a plus if I'm rushing in the mornings. I'm glad it's now being sold in Ulta!
Ive been waiting for this product to arrive!! Its a lightweight cleanser for all skin types definitely would reccomend!
